name: Sudarshanaloka
technique: Mindfulness of breathing and metta bhavana meditation, group and solitary retreat
teacherAccess: Visiting Triratna Order members during organized retreats
retreatOptions: Group retreats/events plus dedicated solitary-retreat huts
about: An 80-hectare, fully off-grid native-forest retreat center purchased in 1993, the land-based arm of New Zealand's Triratna network alongside the urban Auckland Buddhist Centre. Offers both communal retreats and solitary retreat facilities on genuinely dedicated land.
